description: Retrieve InterPro and member-signature matches on a canonical UniProt protein, preserving every location and discontinuous fragment. Optionally select records covering a residue, include extra predicted features, and include functional residue rules with provenance. Budgeted segments hold whole records in order: matches, requested extras, then requested residue rules sorted by key. The first segment carries protein metadata; continue coverage.nextCursor until hasMore is false.

accession.description: Canonical six- or ten-character UniProt accession, without an isoform suffix.

cursor.description: Opaque coverage.nextCursor with unchanged accession, residuePosition, includeExtraFeatures, and includeResidueAnnotations.

includeExtraFeatures.description: Include complete extra predicted features, returned after the last match; defaults to false.

includeResidueAnnotations.description: Include complete functional residue rules after matches and requested extras; defaults to false.

residuePosition.description: Residue position, 1-based and inclusive; must not exceed protein length.

name: interpro_get_protein_domains

cap.description: Most match records one call reads; a segment can stop sooner at the response byte budget.

coverage.description: Where this segment sits in the protein map: matches, requested extra features, then requested residue rules.

complete.description: True only when this call starts without a cursor and returns every match, requested extra feature, and requested residue rule.

hasMore.description: Whether another segment remains, holding matches, requested extras, or requested residue rules.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor resuming at the next whole match, extra feature, or residue rule for the same protein and selection.

returnedFeatures.description: Extra features in this segment; present with extraFeatures.

returnedMatches.description: Selected match records in this segment.

returnedResidueAnnotations.description: Whole residue rules returned in this segment.

scannedMatches.description: Match records this segment covered, before residue filtering; totalMatches is upstream's reported count, and a complete walk can cover a different number.

totalFeatures.description: Selected extra features for this protein and residue; present with extraFeatures.

totalMatches.description: Upstream unfiltered total match count; extra-feature-only and residue-rule-only segments repeat the count reported by the match list.

totalResidueAnnotations.description: Selected residue rules; present only when the residue stage is reached.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The shared fifty-second budget expires across metadata, match pages, extra features, and residue rules. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor decoding or scope fails, the records it resumes inside changed or disagree with it, or upstream rejects continuation. `entry_withdrawn`: InterPro reports a withdrawn record with HTTP 410. `upstream_shape_invalid`: Upstream JSON, structure, or continuation is incompatible. `upstream_response_too_large`: An upstream response exceeds 4 MiB. `upstream_rejected`: InterPro returns an unhandled redirect or client rejection. `upstream_unavailable`: InterPro has a network or server failure; HTTP 501 is not retryable. `upstream_timeout`: InterPro returns HTTP 408/504 or an attempt exceeds its deadline. `upstream_rate_limited`: InterPro returns HTTP 429. `protein_not_found`: Canonical protein detail returns HTTP 204 or 404. `residue_out_of_range`: Requested position exceeds the fetched protein length. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: Complete continuous or discontinuous sequence fragment.

extraFeatures.description: Whole selected extra features in this segment, in feature-key order; {} when none are selected. Omitted when not requested or when this segment ends before the features that follow the last match.

matches.description: Whole selected match records in this segment, sorted by earliest coordinate then accession; a match is never split across segments.

items.description: Complete continuous or discontinuous sequence fragment.

protein.description: Complete upstream protein metadata on the first segment, the call without cursor; continuation segments omit it.

proteome.description: UniProt proteome accession, such as UP000000625; pass it as interpro_find_proteins_by_domain proteomeId with taxonId set to source_organism.taxId or an ancestor. Null when the protein belongs to no proteome.

locations.description: Complete rule locations and residue fragments.

items.description: Complete continuous or discontinuous sequence fragment.

residueAnnotations.description: Whole selected residue rules sorted by key; {} means the stage was reached with no selected rules. Omitted when unrequested or unreached.

selection.description: Applied residue, extra-feature, and residue-rule selection.

includeExtraFeatures.description: Whether extra predicted features were requested.

includeResidueAnnotations.description: Present only when residue rules were requested.

shown.description: Selected match records in this segment.

title: Map protein domains
